info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Site Administration Management API
info.description: The Site Administration Management API provides functionality for overseeing and controlling site-level banking facilities. It allows users to retrieve comprehensive insights regarding various site parameters and configurations essential for effective site management. Typical consumers of this API include administrators and operational managers who require access to site performance metrics and operational status. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their site administration processes, ensuring seamless operations across banking facilities.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves comprehensive details related to site administration, including configurations, settings, and operational insights. Use this endpoint to access all necessary information for effective management of site facilities.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving site administration details in the facilities management system. It should contain parameters necessary for filtering or specific data retrieval as defined in the schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of site administration data.

GetSiteAdministrationRequest.description: A request body represented as a string for the GET operation within site administration functionalities.

items.description: An array of site operation items.

pagination.description: Pagination details for the returned items.

sort.description: The sorting criteria used for the returned items.

GetSiteAdministrationResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operations of the site administration, providing details of items, pagination, sorting, and metadata.

siteId.description: The unique identifier for the site.

assetId.description: The unique identifier for the asset.

workOrderId.description: The unique identifier for the work order.

scheduledDate.description: The scheduled date for the operation.

vendorId.description: The unique identifier for the vendor responsible for the operation.

facilityZone.description: The zone within the facility where the operation is taking place.

maintenanceType.description: The type of maintenance being performed.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: The estimated duration of the operation in minutes.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the operation record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation record was last updated.

SiteOperationItem.description: Represents a single site operation item containing various details.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

totalItems.description: The total number of items available across all pages.

Pagination.description: Details regarding the pagination of the response data.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The ID used to correlate related requests.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Metadata information related to the response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer Authentication mechanism where a JSON Web Token (JWT) is used to authorize requests. Clients must include a bearer token with their requests to access secured endpoints.
